description_expanded: Settle into beach life with all the comforts of home at Blue Sky, a magnificent Gulf-front home in Navarre Beach! With room for a crowd and just steps from the beach, this coastal retreat is an ideal place to unwind with the people you love. Make memories to last a lifetime at your own private sanctuary right on the beach! Blue Sky is a gorgeous three-story home with six bedrooms and six and a half baths accommodating up to twenty. Beautifully furnished and fully appointed, the home welcomes you into spacious interiors to experience the ultimate in coastal living. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows showcase outstanding Gulf-front views and beautiful furnishings create inviting spaces for relaxation throughout the home. A sizeable kitchen features an induction cooktop, upgraded appliances, a wet bar, and plenty of cabinetry, perfect if you need additional room to store ingredients and staples. Spa-like bathrooms and generous bedrooms are welcome luxuries after days spent out exploring the beautiful coastline. Each bedroom is beautifully decorated and features an en suite bathroom, and the kids will love the bunk room, complete with an Xbox 360. Seven televisions and three Blu-Ray DVD players ensure everyone gets to watch their favorite show. Two separate laundry areas, each containing a washer and dryer, are additional conveniences to enjoy during your stay. Take your pick from child-safe decks on each floor for an evening cocktail while taking in some of the most stunning sunsets on the Coast! Take the private boardwalk down to the beach and pass the days soaking up the sun. Cool off in the emerald waters, then help the kids find shells to take back home. A ping pong table will provide hours of entertainment for the whole family, and you’ll find lots of fun activities nearby when you’re ready for a break from the beach. Bikes are not avaliable for guest use however there are several locations on the beach that rent bikes, scooters, golf carts etc. Treat the kids to ice cream at The Twist or a snow cone at Tommy’s Sno Balls, then onto the Gulf Breeze zoo or the Navarre Beach fishing pier. The fun never ends in Navarre Beach! No Boats, No Trailers, or RV parking on the property. Boats, trailers, and RVs will be required to relocate to a public parking lot. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
